verdicts.explanation: Table 2 gives σ300K = 14.090 mS cm−1 and Ea = 0.183 ± 0.016 eV for Li4Hf2Si3O12 (I), and the text states 14.09 mS cm−1 for this NASICON-type compound. The values come from MLIP-MD extrapolated to 300 K, so the computational origin and 300 K temperature are correct.
The Discussion states that undoped Li2Ta2SiO8 has 0.0004 mS cm−1 at 300 K, and Section 2.5 gives the undoped barrier as 0.562 eV. Both the material and the computational origin match the paper.

The Discussion gives 0.193 mS cm−1 at 300 K for Li2.125Ta1.875Hf0.125SiO8, and Section 2.5 gives the Hf-doped barrier as 0.352 eV. Hf is the correct dopant, and the quote refers to the formula stated in the same paragraph.
